active_lifetime.races: Until authorized delivery completes, original setup constraints still apply. No surviving grant claim is made for incomplete failed delivery. Actual owner-authorized failure can retire only its own exact Active attempt. Foreign denial preserves rightful attempt.
active_lifetime.staged_requests: Consumed Selector request deadline bounds successful Prepare only. It does not alone cancel resulting still-live preview/pin after Prepare. Distinct fresh Approval has its own actual event-entry+1000ms deadline for Confirm/activation/delivery, clamped to original pin/preview and configured instance expiry. Pin and preview original lifetimes continue to bound pre-delivery. No deadline reset or inherited consumed Selector deadline into fresh Approval.
